title: Have You Seen These Places Too?
content: does anyone visit the same stores or restaurants in the mallworld? if i’m at the actual mall there are certain places in the food court i know are my favorites and i remember what kind of foods they sold that were so strange yet seemed normal to me there. and there’s a very expensive designer store that only exists there that i feel very uncomfortable in and the employees are confused about me being there. there are huge stores similar to a macys that take up two floors and i remember the areas that have the clothes i like that fit me and the makeup department. there was an exclusive restaurant that was very dark and im not allowed in there at all to this day and it has a red carpet leading down a hallway and i dont know where it goes. there is a toy store i dont go into often because its always crowded but i know its there. there’s even a store that sells perfumes and soaps. ive been to a theatre with live actors and actresses. my outside city has the same roads and houses and buildings and there are scary areas and fancy nice areas and everything in between that i frequent regularly. there’s a hotel that i know i can get a room at even though i don’t know where it is until i get there and sometimes i get caught and kicked out. there is a times square type of area? it’s just very bright and colorful and lots of screens showing off different kinds of a shows to go to. the worst one i get trapped in is the school. there is a huge auditorium that actually feels more like a church sanctuary that is dark and has several steep rows of chairs. lots of endless hallways with dim dark or bright lighting. tons of stairs and elevators and the same classrooms with the same teachers and students although i can’t remember them. parts of the school are abandoned or off limits and other parts are full of students and people. i could go on and on. i don’t really dream anywhere besides this place. i lucid dream there a lot too and have had meltdowns begging people to explain what is going on and if im dreaming and sometimes they will pretend they cant hear me or dont know what to say and sometimes they so no im not dreaming that this is real and sometimes they say i am dreaming and tell me where to go to wake up and i often go there and cross a threshold and it starts the dream over or i believe im awake but ive just “woken up” into another place in the dream that im familiar with and it slowly occurs to me that im still dreaming. i dont recall ever having dream police but i am constantly being chased and its always the apocalypse.
